Question
========
What does the statement of purpose in a DMP clarify?

Answerlist
----------
* Whether there is a conflict of interests involved
* The budget of the project
* The research question or business goal
* The authors and the participants of the project


Solution
========
The statement of purpose clarifies the research question or business goal.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* False
* True
* False
